Name: Eugene Custom NPC - English Translation
Author: Sapiescent
Description:
[b][color=#b6d7a8][size=3][i]About Eugene[/i][/size][/color][/b]
[quote]Eugene is a gentle soul living in solitude amongst his flowers. Though anxious about meeting the new farmer, he appreciates the company.
He spends his time tending to the garden, baking, and experiencing the occasional existential crisis about the transience of happiness.
Something has been troubling him for many years. Will you be the one to give him guidance?[/quote]
[b][color=#d9ead3][i]Currently, Eugene...[/i][/color][/b]
[list]
[*]Is a new, fully romanceable and marriageable NPC with around 200 lines of dialogue, including custom responses to birthday gifts and receiving a Bouquet or Mermaid's Pendant
[*]Has a Spouse Room, Spouse Patio and Spouse Portrait if you decide to marry him
[*]Is present in every vanilla festival (although for one you might need to reach him through [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3900]other means[/url]﻿...)
[*]Has a total of 10 heart events, ranging from 0 to 14 hearts
[*]Has his house visible in the World Map, compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6367]VPR[/url]﻿, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5255]Earthy[/url]﻿, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21085]Starblue[/url]﻿, and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/36292]Retro[/url]﻿﻿ Recolor.
[*]Includes [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11491]Nyapu Portraits[/url]﻿, which you can enable through the config (courtesy of [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/nyapu]Nyapu[/url]﻿ - thank you so much for these!)
[*]Is fully compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url]﻿, [url=https://ko-fi.com/s/f5b179e3f1]Overgrown Valley[/url]﻿, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8265]Romanceable Rasmodia[/url]﻿, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14426]Gender Neutrality Mod Tokens[/url]﻿ and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20972]Simple Foliage[/url]﻿ - this mod will automatically adjust when any of them are also installed
[/list][line]
[b][color=#b6d7a8][size=3][i]Schedule and Gift Tastes[/i][/size][/color][/b]
Eugene lives in Cindersap Forest, south of Marnie's Ranch and past the river, away from everyone else. You can usually find him either inside or outside his house, taking care of his flowers. If you have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]SVE[/url], his house is instead under the pond, closer to the Wizard's Tower.
[spoiler]
Most days he'll stay inside his house in the morning, working around his garden, and he'll go tend the flowers outside in the afternoon. By sunset he'll be back inside his room.

During Friday evenings he goes to visit a certain friend that also lives in the forest, and on Sunday nights he visits the Graveyard in Pelican Town.
[/spoiler]
When it comes to gifts, flowers are your best bet! Most baked goods are also a good idea. Things like monster loot and poisonous items, on the other hand, aren't exactly something you should be gifting to a gardener.
[spoiler]
[b]Love:[/b] All Flowers, Ancient Fruit, Salad, Honey, Green Tea and Poppyseed Muffin - all Tea and Muffins from other mods (with the [i]tea_item[/i] and [i]muffin_item[/i] context tag, like [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27049]WAG[/url]'s) are loved too!
[b]Like:[/b] Foraged Flowers, Baked goods, most Artisan goods, Vegetable Medley, Fruit Salad, Fertilizers & Retaining Soils, Tea Leaves and Maple Syrup - all bakery items and bouquets from other mods (with the [i]food_bakery[/i], [i]food_salad[/i] and [i]bouquet_item[/i] context tag, like [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27049]WAG[/url]'s) are loved too!
[b]Dislike/Hate:[/b] Trash, Monster Loot, poisonous items and most Resources
[/spoiler]
[line]
[b][color=#b6d7a8][size=3][i]Heart Events[/i][/size][/color][/b]
Eugene has a total of 10 events: 5 are the standard 0, 2, 4, 6 and 8♥ events, 2 require dating him (both at 10♥) and 3 marrying him (all three at 14♥).
As such, keep in mind part of his story can only be seen by dating and marrying him.
Also note that some events must be seen in order (e.g. you must have seen the 8♥ event to see the 10♥ one).

[b][i][color=#d9ead3]Requirements guide:[/color][/i][/b] [spoiler][list]
[*][b]0[/b][b]♥[/b][b][/b][b]:[/b] Introduction event, enter Eugene's House at any time (ID 80001)
[*][b]2♥:[/b] Enter Eugene's Room while he's there (ID 80002)
[*][b]4♥:[/b] Enter the Town on a weekend between 7pm-12am (ID 80004)
[*][b]6♥:[/b] Enter Eugene's House at any time (ID 80003)
[*][b]8♥:[/b] Enter Eugene's Room while he's there (ID 80005)
[*][b]10♥ pt.1:[/b] Enter the Farm between 6am and 10am on a clear day (ID 800061)
[*][b]10♥ pt.2:[/b] Enter the Forest between 7pm and 1:40am (ID 80006)
[*][b]14♥ pt.1:[/b] Enter the Farm between 9pm and 2am on a clear weekday (ID 8000140)
[*][b]14♥ pt.2:[/b] Enter the Farm between 6am and 12pm on a clear weekend (ID 8000141)
[*][b]14♥ pt.3:[/b] Enter Eugene's house on a weekend (ID 8000142)
[/list][/spoiler][line]
[b][color=#b6d7a8][size=3][i]Compatibility[/i][/size][/color][/b]
Most mods are compatible by default, including all recolors, and there are no known incompatible mods. Do let us know if you find any incompatibilities and/or bugs, though!

That being said, mods that are actively supported are:
[list]
[*][b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url]:[/b] Eugene's house will be moved closer to the Wizard's Tower if you have SVE
[*][b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8265]Romanceable Rasmodia[/url]﻿:[/b] If installed, any mentions of the Wizard will be replaced with the Witch Rasmodia
[*][b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14426]Gender Neutrality Mod Tokens[/url]﻿:[/b] The pronouns the player is referred to as will match those chosen in GNMT's config menu
[*][b][url=https://ko-fi.com/s/f5b179e3f1]Overgrown Valley[/url]:[/b] Eugene's schedule will be adjusted so he doesn't step on Merlin's grave when he's in town
[/list][line]
[b][i][color=#b6d7a8][size=3]Add-ons[/size][/color][/i][/b]
Some recommended mods that include things related to Eugene:[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14848]Alternate Portraits for Eugene[/url]﻿[b]:[/b] Gives Eugene more vanilla-looking portraits
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22270]PixelPals Plushies[/url]﻿[b]:[/b] Adds an adorable, tiny Eugene plush
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/36161]Modded NPCs Portraits[/url]﻿[b]:[/b] Gives Eugene his very own spouse portrait - while 2.0.0 already adds one, Fudge's is different and obtainable without having to marry him
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/32799]Eugene for Mobile Phone[/url]﻿[b]:[/b] Adds dialogue and event reminiscence keys for Eugene to the Mobile Phone mod
[/list][line]
[b][color=#b6d7a8][size=3][i]Notes[/i][/size][/color][/b][list]
[*]Eugene is safe to install or uninstall at any time, but if adding him to an existing playthrough remember to use [url=https://github.com/Lake1059/ResetTerrainFeatures_NET6/releases/tag/1.0.3-unofficial.3-Lake1059]Reset Terrain Features[/url]﻿ to clear the area, lest the forest debris consume him
[*]You can sit on his benches! [size=1](It's silly, I know, but I love it -vikich3rry)[/size]
[*]This is a machine translation that has been cleaned up, grammar checked and playtested. Feel free to suggest improvements or point out errors
[*]While at its core this is just an English translation and Eugene fully belongs to Leroy, do note that we've added quite a lot to the mod that isn't yet available in the original Korean version. Leroy has been contacted about this, however, so if they wish to implement these features to the original mod or take them out of this one we'll always follow their wishes!
[/list][line]
